'''Delia Visi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], she was involved in the "[[Rori Incident]]" bombing of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military facility in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] and as a result became one of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild's]] top 10 most wanted fugitives. An unknown [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked her down and killed her.
